scripts.dev: concurrently --names "api,matcher,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix matcher" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix matcher && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:test-data
scripts.record:demo: node scripts/assert-node-record-demo.mjs && playwright test -c playwright.demo.config.ts && node scripts/copy-demo-video.mjs
